reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Tribute to Secretary-General's AI governance leadership
themes.definition: Opening-section tributes crediting the UN Secretary-General with championing global AI governance or international AI cooperation.
themes.inclusion: Include passages praising the SG or UN initiatives specifically for work on AI governance or AI cooperation.
themes.exclusion: Exclude tributes to the SG that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: A tribute listing AI among many SG initiatives still counts if AI is explicitly named as an SG effort.

examples.quote: a champion of the global debate on global governance of artificial intelligence
to strengthen international cooperation on artificial intelligence

themes.label: Uncontrolled AI as survival risk
themes.definition: Framing uncontrolled or ungoverned AI development as a risk to the survival of humanity or an existential-scale threat.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing AI as a risk to humanity's survival or as an existential threat due to lack of control or governance.
themes.exclusion: Exclude military-specific AI risks and generic references to challenges of technology.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Un-governed AI' listed among existential threats is borderline between this and AI_CRISIS_LIST_MENTION; code both if the passage uses existential language.

examples.quote: the very real risks to the survival of humanity posed by the uncontrolled development of artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI listed among global crises
themes.definition: AI named briefly in a catalogue of global challenges or crises (climate, pandemics, conflict) without further discussion.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears only as one item in a list of global threats or challenges motivating UN reform.
themes.exclusion: Exclude lists of technologies or achievements (AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION) and passages that elaborate AI's risks.
themes.boundary_cases: If the list item carries a qualifier like 'uncontrolled' with explicit survival language, code AI_SAFETY_EXISTENTIAL instead.

examples.quote: a range of challenges, including climate change, pandemics, un-governed artificial intelligence, and energy insecurity

themes.label: Two worlds: AI advance versus poverty
themes.definition: Contrasting a world advancing into AI and the fourth industrial revolution with a world left in poverty and marginalization, and calling to narrow the gap.
themes.inclusion: Include passages depicting a widening gap between AI-advanced and marginalized countries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages about inequality that do not reference AI or technology.
themes.boundary_cases: A follow-on passage calling to narrow 'this gap' without naming AI counts only when read with the preceding AI reference.

examples.quote: One is rapidly advancing toward the fourth industrial revolution and artificial intelligence, while the other remains hostage to poverty and marginalization.
It requires us to unite our efforts to devise solutions that are capable of narrowing this gap

value.rationale: All passages are speech openings with protocol tributes and surveys of global conditions; AI appears briefly as an SG achievement, a survival risk, a listed challenge, or a marker of the development divide.
